descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S19 Each item delete asks once, and Cancel keeps the item: medication row, Encounter task, Post-Round task and Important Point, in both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Every delete asks for confirmation exactly once, in both modes: a medication row, a task (Encounter or Post-Round), an Important Point, and the other one-tap delete controls on the charts — a previou … (UAT TC-24; TFA-94699 AC 6; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident each seeded with a medication row, tasks and an Important Point

When For each item kind: tap its delete control once, press Cancel if a confirmation appears, save a checkpoint; then tap again and confirm. After the deletes, check that each item is gone.

Then Every kind shows one confirmation; after Cancel the item is still there; after OK it is gone, in both modes.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U8 / TFA-94699 AC 6. A delete with no confirmation removes the item at the first tap, so the after-Cancel checkpoint (mustContain the item) fails. The medication cells are taken inside the Medications editor right after the first Remove tap, before Save or the editor's own Cancel: without a confirmation the row has already left the editor's list. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
